svg.title: ERP | Full system class diagram (all bounded-context objects)

g.text: ERP | Full system class diagram (all bounded-context objects)
Solid line + multiplicity: in-service ORM association (real foreign key).
Dashed arrow: cross-table/cross-service logical reference or derived dependency; NOT a database foreign key.
Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization (structural typing, no runtime inheritance).
Four bounded contexts (Identity, Academic, Finance, HR) own separate databases; there are
no cross-database foreign keys. Diagram consolidates the 06-09 ERDs into one object model
per the assignment's "capture every object, attribute and relation" class-diagram requirement.
05-domain-classes.puml remains the focused Finance/payroll implementation-collaboration view.
